تستكشفوا (form X)
# تَسْتَكْشِفُوا (tastakšifū) /tas.tak.ʃi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْشَفَ (istakšafa)
# تُسْتَكْشَفُوا (tustakšafū) /tus.tak.ʃa.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْشَفَ (istakšafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
